# Stage 16 Frontier Ledger

## Exact geometric theorem

Let `P_i=U S_i`.  Bi-invariance gives
`d(S_i,S_j)=d(P_i,P_j)`.  If the staples are not contained in any common
`eta`-ball, their diameter exceeds `eta`; therefore, for every `U`,

```text
max_i d(I,P_i) > eta/2,
sum_i d(I,P_i)^2 > eta^2/2.
```

## Compatibility result

Good-collar control requires `eta<rho/sqrt(m)`.  Hence the greatest possible
local total-energy exponent is `rho^2/(4 m t)`.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---:|
| frozen exponent | `0.933888889` |
| target `K` | `7` |
| maximum time from total energy | `4.00238095e-7` |
| maximum time from radial rate | `1.21141680e-7` |

The radial rate is zero at the frozen scale because the charge radius lies
below the mean three-dimensional Gaussian radius.

## Consequence

The direct one-link collar split cannot close the declared ultraviolet budget.
This does not rule out multi-link integration, coarse collars, center-contour
charges, or a different ultraviolet witness.
